Ou seja, se a Modalidade A tiver 10 inscritos e a B, 5, e você se inscrever nos dois, nós excluiremos a sua inscrição da Modalidade A. Você não precisa se inscrever em todas as modalidades. Se não desejar participar de nenhuma das duas que acontecerem em determinado momento, não precisa se inscrever em nenhuma. Caso deseje alterar seus eventos, deve contactar os Delegados ou Organização. Quaisquer outras dúvidas, favor contatar os delegados. **PLEASE NOTE** This competition will be run in a different way to the others, you will have to choose an event from the following to take part in: 3x3 or 2x2 4x4 or OH Pyraminx or Skewb 5x5 or Square-1 You can't compete in two of these events at the same time. If you sign up for two of them, we'll take it into account as if you'd chosen the one with fewer participants. In other words, if Event A has 10 entrants and Event B has 5, and you sign up for both, we will exclude your entry from Event A. You don't have to sign up for all Events. If you don't want to take part in either of the two taking place at any given time, you don't need to register for either. If you want to change your events, you must contact the Delegates or the Organization team. If you have any other questions, please contact the delegates **AOS NOVATOS:** Por favor, enviar um email para [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) ou trazer um documento com foto, data de nascimento e nome completo para fins de completação do processo de registro. **FOR NEWCOMERS:** Please send an email to [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) or bring an ID that contains a photo, date of birth and full name to complete the registration process. Inscrição de competidor: R$ 25,00 A entrada do público será livre. items.information: # Português • A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. • Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. • **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. • **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. • As inscrições custam R$ 25,00 (vinte e cinco reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). • Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 30,00 (trinta reais), caso haja vagas. • # English • Registration is open to any person, from any country. • To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. • **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. • **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. • Registration costs R$25.00 (twenty five Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). • On-site registrations will be accepted for R$30,00 (Thirty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI3NDQ5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8508a7db554ceb1fb5f2737c95b0d49e690d3fcb/Blue%20and%20White%20Circle%20Surfing%20Club%20Logo%20(11).png) **Español** Con mucha alegría y orgullo anunciamos en colaboración con la Universidad de La Frontera, que Temuco será por primera vez sede de una competencia oficial de Cubo Rubik. Más que una competencia, "UFRO al Cubo 2025" será una oportunidad única para compartir la pasión por el mundo Rubik y disfrutar de un ambiente lleno de colores, cubos y comunidad. ¡Los esperamos! **English** It is with great joy and pride that we announce, in collaboration with the Universidad De La Frontera, that Temuco will host an official Rubik's Cube competition for the first time. More than just a competition, "UFRO al Cubo 2025" will be a unique opportunity to share the passion for the Rubik's Cube and enjoy an atmosphere full of colors, cubes, and community. We look forward to seeing you!

Don't miss this unmissable event! This competition is organized in collaboration with the [+FECSH](https://www.instagram.com/masfecsh_ufro/?hl=es) Program and the [UFRO Faculty of Engineering and Sciences Student Council](https://www.instagram.com/cee.fica/?hl=es). items.name: UJCV Cubing Honduras 2026

venue.name: [Universidad José Cecilio del Valle](https://ujcv.edu.hn/)
venue.address: Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, Boulevar Roberto Romero Larios, Comayagua

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1NDc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--72b0f75423beefdc650f133783cee9ed7de0cd11/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-01-13%20at%2010.05.16%20AM.jpeg) Esta competencia forma parte de una serie de tres eventos que se desarrollarán a lo largo del año 2026, coincidiendo con los tres períodos académicos. El objetivo principal de esta serie es fortalecer el desarrollo del speedcubing en Honduras, brindar más oportunidades de competencia oficial y contribuir a la mejora progresiva de los tiempos y rankings a nivel nacional. El evento se llevará a cabo en la Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, campus Comayagua, institución que brinda el espacio y apoyo logístico para la realización de competencias oficiales WCA, reconociendo el valor educativo, formativo y tecnológico del speedcubing. _______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ This competition is part of a series of three events that will take place throughout 2026, corresponding to the three academic periods. The main objective of this series is to strengthen the development of speedcubing in Honduras, provide more opportunities for official competition, and contribute to the progressive improvement of national times and rankings. The event will be held at Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, Comayagua campus, which provides the venue and logistical support for the organization of official WCA competitions, recognizing the educational, formative, and technological value of speedcubing.

items.name: UK 20th Anniversary 2026

venue.name: The Edge, Leeds
venue.address: The Edge University of Leeds Leeds, LS2 9JT

items.information: #### Celebrating 20 years since the first WCA competition in the UK! ##### On November 18th, 2006, the UK hosted its first ever WCA competition, and since then we have gone on to hold over 350 more across the country. For this very special anniversary we're returning to where it all started, to celebrate the UK cubing scene, and another 20 years of success! T-Shirts for this competition will be available to buy separately on the UKCA website closer to the competition. Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

items.name: UK Championship 2019
items.information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **Qualification Requirements**: If you do not meet the qualification requirements in competition *before* 11 October 2019, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the [Qualification tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKChampionship2019#9139-qualification) to see all times required. **Final Round Advancements**: For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors. **Please Note**: As this is the UK Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyNzIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf638126f96e668f65b37e3ce68edb80c6d49543/upen%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026. El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026. UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: Esta será la octava competición en UTN FRBA, y la primera en la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires en 2020. Durará dos días a lo largo de un fin de semana, y tendrá un total de 17 rondas en 10 eventos, incluyendo un mo3 de Resolución en Menos Movimientos. **No es necesario asistir a los dos días.** This will be the eighth competition hosted in UTN FRBA and the first one in Buenos Aires City in the year 2020. It will span across two days over the weekend and feature a total of 10 events in 17 rounds, including a Fewest Moves mo3. **Competitors are not required to attend both days.**

items.information: ## 청주에서 열리는 첫 WCA 대회! WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2025#65266-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2025#65265-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ## First WCA competition in Cheongju City! If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2025#65266-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2025#65265-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information: ## Змагання в підтримку України #### Будемо раді бачити як і новачків, так і професіоналів. Уся актуальна інформація по змаганнях буде у [чаті змагань] (https://t.me/UkrainianNationals2023), тут ви можете і задавати свої питання по змаганням. Також слідкуйте у [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61551082552131&is_tour_completed=true) та [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ukranian_nationals_2023/). #### Змагання знаходяться в укритті, проте ознайомтесь з розділом ["Запобіжні заходи"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UkrainianNationals2023#33351-safety-measures). Також ознайомтесь з розділом ["Волонтерам"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UkrainianNationals2023#33327-volunteering) #### Всі не витрачені з реєстрації кошти будуть передані у благодійни фонд [Superhumans](https://superhumans.com/en/) ## Competitions in support of Ukraine #### We will be glad to see both beginners and professionals. All the latest information about the competition will be in the [competition chat](https://t.me/UkrainianNationals2023), where you can also ask your questions about the competition. Also, follow our [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61551082552131&is_tour_completed=true) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ukranian_nationals_2023/). #### The competition is located in a shelter, but please read the section "Precautions". Please also read the section ["For foreigners"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UkrainianNationals2023#33458-for-foreigners) #### All funds not spent on registration will be transferred to Charity Fund [Superhumans](https://superhumans.com/en/)

items.information: Registration will be closed May, 26 or when we will reach 300 approved competitors. Реєстрацію буде закрито 26 травня або коли кількість підтверджених учасників досягне 300. Registration fee: one event — $2; few events — $4. Реєстраційний внесок: одна дисципліна — 50 грн; кілька дисциплін — 100 грн. To speed up registration process at the venue, please pay registration fee in advance. You will be informed by e-mail about possible payment methods. Thanks for understanding! Щоб прискорити процес реєстрації на змаганнях, прохання сплатити реєстраційний внесок заздалегідь. Ви будете повідомлені електронною поштою про можливі методи оплати. Дякуємо за розуміння! Spectators are welcome. There is no entry fee for spectators. Будемо раді бачити вас в якості глядачів. Вхід безкоштовний.

items.information: (BR) Bem-vindos à primeira competição oficial em Rio do Sul! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos de inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_ Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada) **Inscrições no local da competição serão aceitas somente para o evento 3x3x3.** (EN) Welcome to the first official competition in Rio do Sul! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_ Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.) **On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 event.**

venue.name: Fyris Park

items.information: #### Svenska # Denna tävling har ställts in på grund av förändrade COVID-19 restriktioner. Välkomna till Uppsala Open 2022, en mysig endagstävling i Stenhagen, Uppsala. Det här är första gången en tävling hålls i Uppsala på 7 år! Glöm inte att läsa igenom alla flikar för viktig information gällande tävlingen. *Du får välja mellan att delta i antingen 6x6/7x7, eller 4bld/5bld. 4bld och 5bld kommer hållas på "Side stage", samtidigt som 6x6 och 7x7.* **På grund av regeringens nya restriktioner så kommer alla vuxna deltagare och gäster över 18 år behöva visa Covidbevis (vaccinationsbevis) för att få vistas i lokalen. Mer information om detta finns under fliken "COVID-19.** #### English # This competition has been cancelled due to a change in COVID-19 restrictions. Welcome to Uppsala Open 2022, a cozy one day competition in Stenhagen, Uppsala. This is the first time a competition is held in Uppsala in 7 years! Do not forget to read all of the tabs for important information regarding the competition. *You may choose to compete either in 6x6/7x7, or 4bld/5bld. 4bld and 5bld will be held at the side stage, at the same time as 6x6 and 7x7.* **Due to the Swedish government's new restrictions, all adult competitors and guests over the age of 18 will need to show a vaccination certificate to be allowed to be present at the venue. items.name: Ural Autumn 2020
items.information: На чемпионат нужно принести с собой медицинскую маску , перчатки и ручку . Участие на чемпиоате в маске и перчатках , в момент официальных сборок можно будет снимать маску и перчатки. Скрамблить и судить строго в маске и перчатках. И всегда делать подпись только своей ручкой . You need to bring a medical mask, gloves and a pen to the championship. Participation in the championship wearing a mask and gloves, at the time of official assemblies it will be possible to take off the mask and gloves. Scrub and judge strictly with a mask and gloves. And always sign with only your own pen.

items.information: [TR] Kayıt sırasında adınızı ve soyadınızı lütfen kimlikte yazıldığı gibi hatasız giriniz. İlk harfleri büyük yazınız. Yarışmaya gelirken yanınızda kimlik bulundurmayı unutmayınız. Katılım ücreti için internet üzerinden başvuru yapıldıktan sonra i.kuleli@gmail.com adresine mail atarak belirtiniz. Katılımcı limiti dolmadan önce ödemeyi yapmanız gerekmektedir. İnternet üzerinden ödenecek ücret 50 TL'dir. Gerekli bilgiler mailde verilecektir. 21 Ekim'e kadar iptal durumunda katılım ücreti iadesi yapılacaktır, sonrasında ücret iadesi yoktur. Online ödeme yapanlar yarışma listesinde önceliklidir. Yarışma günü kayıt masasında ücret ödeyecekler, katılımcı sınırı dolmadığı takdirde girişte 70 TL ödeyeceklerdir. [EN] Please enter your name and surname during registration as it is writter on your ID. The First letters are capital letters. Dont forget to have an ID card with you when you come to the competition. Please send an e-mail to i.kuleli@gmail.com for the registration fee on the internet, after registered on WCA. Pay as soon as possible after you register, otherwise the limit can be reached and you will not be able to compete. The fee to be paid over the internet is 50 TL. The necessary information will be given in the mail. In case of cancellation up to October 21st, registration fees will be refunded. After 21st the fee will not be refunded. Online payers have priority in the competition list. Unless the competitor limit reached, those who pay the registration fee on the day of the competition will pay 70 TL.

Both competitions will happen on the same day in the same venue. All-Stars is an exciting opportunity for the best of Utah to compete against each other. If you are an experienced competitor, even if you don't consider yourself to be the best of the best, we ask that you register for this competition. If you are a first time or less experienced competitor (competed for the first time in 2024, 2025, 2026 or otherwise consider yourself to be less experienced), we strongly encourage you to register for Utah Newcomers, as the scheduling of both competitions has been tailored specifically to improve the expereince for you. The most unique aspect of this competition is how the schedules have been interleaved. For each event, the finals of All-Stars will immediately preceed the first round of the same event of this competition. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). items.name: Uzbekistan Open 2017
items.information: Registration is full now. You can still register, but you will be placed on a waiting list and you can only compete if other people cancel. So your chances are small. ================== This is the first WCA competition in Uzbekistan. We hope after this competition many more will follow. Around 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email to confirm your participation. Please make sure to check your mailbox and spam box around that time. If you do not confirm, then you will removed from the list of competitors. You can pay the registration fee on-site in the venue. ========== Это первые соревнования WCA в Узбекистане. Мы надеемся, что после этого соревнования последуют много других. Примерно за 1-2 недели до начала соревнования вы получите электронное письмо, чтобы подтвердить свое участие. Обязательно проверяйте свой почтовый ящик и спам за 1-2 недели до соревнований. Если участие не будет подтверждено то участник будет удален из списка конкурсантов. Вы можете оплатить регистрационный сбор на месте в месте проведения. ========== Bu Uzbekistondagi birinchi WCA musobaqalari. Umid qilamiz-ki, bu musobaqadan keyin, boshqa koplab musobaqlar amalga oshiriladi. Ishtirokingizni tasdiqlash uchun musobaqadan 1-2 hafta oldin elektron pochta olasiz. Musoboqadan 1-2 hafta oldin pochtangizni va spam papkasini tekshirib turing. Ishtirokchi qatnashishini tasdiqlamasa, qatnashuvchilar ro'yxatidan o'chiriladi. Ro'yhatga olish narxini musbaqa bo'ladigan joyda to'lashingiz mumkin.

items.information: **VID Cubing 2022** Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA. El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio. _____ **English version** **VID Cubing 2022** Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA. The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition. We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

items.name: Vancouver Newcomers Afternoon 2024
items.information: **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will **reserve 35 spots for new competitors**. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** - 35 spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 40 spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 35 new competitors register before 40 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 2 guest each. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell. items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).** * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office. * **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open A 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång på en **fredag** och i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Denna tävling har endast grenarna 3x3x3 och 2x2x2, och riktar sig främst till elever och lärare på Ålidenskolan, men alla andra är självklart också välkomna att delta. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time on a **Friday** and in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! This competition only has the events 3x3x3 and 2x2x2, and is primarily aimed at students and teachers at Ålidenskolan, but everyone else is of course also welcome to participate. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information about the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.name: Veenendaal Open 2018
items.information: Deelname kost € 7 voor 1 dag of € 10 voor beide dagen. Er is plek voor 130 deelnemers per dag. Gasten zijn welkom. Aanmelding sluit 19 juni (of eerder als het maximumaantal deelnemers is bereikt). Participation fee € 7 for 1 day or € 10 for both days. Maximum 130 participants per day. Guests are welcome. Registration will close June 19 (or earlier when the maximum number of participants has been reached). [Website Veenendaal Open](http://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/veenendaal-open 2018)

items.name: Veenendaal Open 2020
items.information: De eerste 1,5 meter wedstrijd in Nederland! Let op: er is slechts een beperkt aantal plekken en er gelden aangepaste regels. Maximaal 1 begeleider per deelnemer (van te voren aanmelden via het betaalformulier). ____ The first 1,5 meter competition in the Netherlands! Please note: there are only a limited number of spots available and there are modified rules. Max. 1 companion per competitor (register in advance via the payment form).

items.name: Veenendaal Open 2021
items.information: Wedstrijd met coronatoegangsbewijs en aanvullende WCA safety maatregelen. Maximaal 1 begeleider per deelnemer (van te voren aanmelden via het betaalformulier). Alle deelnemers en bezoekers van 13 jaar en ouder hebben een coronatoegangsbewijs nodig én moeten een ID-bewijs kunnen tonen. Voor deelnemers van 6-12 jaar geldt het advies om van te voren een zelftest af te nemen. Zie https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/onderwerpen/coronavirus-covid-19/cultuur-uitgaan-en-sport/coronatoegangsbewijs en https://coronacheck.nl/nl/faq-scanner ____ Competition with 'coronatoegangsbewijs' and additonal WCA safety measures. Max. 1 companion per competitor (register in advance via the payment form). For all competitors and visitors of 13 years and older, the 'coronatoegangsbewijs' ánd ID-card is mandatory. For competitors of age 6-12 years it is recommended to do a selftest before the event. See https://coronacheck.nl/en/faq-scanner

items.information: "Vení a Cubear" será la primera competencia en este departamento. Se tendrán protocolos de bioseguridad por pandemia y los requeridos por la WCA, para permitir la realización de competencias con el mejor ambiente posible. Deberá usarse mascarilla todo el tiempo, habrá alcohol en gel y se tomará la temperatura al registrarse. Se aceptará como máximo un acompañante por competidor. "Vení a Cubear" will be the first competition on that region. There will be biosecurity protocols due to the pandemia, and those required by the WCA as well, to allow a good environment while holding competitions. Use of face mask is mandatory all day, also there will be gel alcohol and temperature will be measured at the entrance. A maximum of one guest will be allowed for each competitor.

items.name: Vento Negro Gravataí 2026
items.information: **Venha para um campeonato de dia único em um lindo local com infraestutura completa para passar o dia com a família em meio à natureza, pertinho da capital! ** O salão de eventos onde ocorrerá o campeonato fica em um complexo dentro de um parque ecológico privado com amplo estacionamento e com restaurante parceiro no local. Organizamos essa competição pensando no conforto dos competidores e acompanhantes. Queremos que todos sejam muito bem-vindos: em caso de dúvida, sintam-se livres para contatar no 51 99860 1894. local: https://www.instagram.com/complexoventonegroeventos buffet: https://www.instagram.com/refugiodosaborventonegro **Português** Valor de inscrição será de R$(25) a ser pago via pix para **(51998601894)** (enviar o comprovante para o e-mail luiz.m_k@hotmail.com ou para o whatsapp 5551998601894). Por favor, caso você se inscreva mas decida não ir ao campeonato, por favor nos informe para que possamos programar corretamente a quantidade de competidores. O competidor poderá se inscrever em quantas modalidades desejar. Pedimos que não se inscreva nas modalidades que não possui intenção de participar. É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). O Buffet é livre no valor de R$(42), com desconto para confirmações até uma semana antes do evento (até dia 11) . O valor com desconto é de R$(38) e o pagamento segue as mesmas regras do pagamento da inscrição. **English** Registration fee is R$(25) and payment with PIX method, to the key **(51998601894)** (send the receipt to luiz.m_k@hotmail.com) . Please, if you register but decide not to come for the competition, please let us know so we can better figure out the number of competitor's to expect. The competitor can register for every event that he wants, we just ask to not register to events you're not certain at participating. Every competitor must have read WCA's Rules (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: The cost of registration is $3n+1, where n is the number of events you will be competing in. Participants in the Footsolving round will be charged an additional $7 to cover equipment value depreciation and other miscellaneous issues. For those of you doing math, this means that we charge $3 for every event except footsolving, and $10 for footsolving. $1 from each registration is charged as the WCA fee, and goes towards maintenance of the WCA database and other miscellaneous items.

items.name: Vienna Autumn 2024

venue.name: [Großer Saal - Pfarre Akkonplatz](https://www.akkonplatz.at/index.php/de/raeume-nutzen/grossersaal)
venue.details: Follow the signs to enter the venue.

items.information: ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Autumn 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Autumn 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng. Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab. # Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5 Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau: * Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công. * Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng. Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp). # Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu. ________________________________________________________________ We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds. Refer to the tabs for more information. # Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria: * The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result. * The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event. Competitors who fail to meet these criteria will **not be allowed to compete in the respective event** and will receive a full refund of any event fees for the events (if already paid). # Notice on Filming and Photography The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises, **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclJwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2901c91547887dda589a7979741476bc143c0896/vietnamcube%20(1).png)

Puedes hacerte socio de la AES [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). * Los socios de la AGS (Asociación Galega de Speedcubing) recibirán un descuento del 15%. Puedes hacerte socio de la [AGS](https://www.galiciaspeedcubing.org/) de forma presencial en el campeonato. Para los descuentos, el pago se debe hacer como todos los competidores y tras la competición se devolverá el importe de los descuentos. Al registrarte en esta competición aceptas que se te enviarán correos electrónicos informativos y se te podrá solicitar confirmación de asistencia mediante correo electrónico. **Si no se recibe dicha confirmación, tu registro puede ser anulado sin reembolso.** Por favor, leed los correos que os enviemos antes de la competición ya que pueden contener información **importante**. Además, todos los competidores deben leer las pestañas de [Información Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72861-informacion-importante-important-information) y de Preguntas Más Frecuentes ([PMF](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72860-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) para el correcto desarrollo de la competición. Un registro se considera completo una vez se ha realizado el pago correspondiente. Los registros completos serán aceptados manualmente en orden de pago y aparecerán en la lista de competidores hasta alcanzar el límite de competidores. Una vez alcanzado este límite los registros completos serán añadidos a la [lista de espera](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72865-lista-de-espera-waiting-list). #![Bandera GAL](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NDY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1d55857fc84f004f1a94c2a3ddbc1ad3a591c62f/1F3F4-E0065-E0073-E0067-E0061-E007F_color.png) * Os socios da AES (Asociación Española de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AES aquí. * Os socios da AGS (Asociación Galega de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AGS de forma presencial no campionato. Para aplicar os descontos, o pago debe facerse igual que o resto dos competidores e, despois da competición, devolverase o importe correspondente aos descontos. Ao rexistrarte nesta competición aceptas que se che enviarán correos electrónicos informativos e que se che poderá solicitar confirmación de asistencia mediante correo electrónico. Se non se recibe esa confirmación, o teu rexistro pode ser anulado sen reembolso. Por favor, lede os correos que vos enviemos antes da competición, xa que poden conter información importante. Ademais, todos os competidores deben ler as lapelas de Información Importante e de Preguntas Máis Frecuentes (PMF) para o correcto desenvolvemento da competición. Un rexistro considérase completo unha vez realizado o pago correspondente. Os rexistros completos serán aceptados manualmente por orde de pago e aparecerán na lista de competidores ata acadar o límite establecido. Unha vez alcanzado este límite, os rexistros completos serán engadidos á lista de espera. #![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png) * The AES members (Spanish Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the AES [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). * The AGS members (Galician Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the [AGS](https://www.galiciaspeedcubing.org/) at the competition. For discounts, the payment must be made as all other competitors and after the competition the discounts will be returned. By registering to this competition you accept that informative emails will be sent to you and you might be asked for an attendance confirmation via email. **If said confirmation is not received, your registration may be deleted without refund.** Please, read the emails that we will send to you before the competitions since they may include **important** information. Moreover, all the competitors must read the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72861-informacion-importante-important-information) and Frequently Asked Questions ([FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72860-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) tabs for the correct development of the competition. items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Taxas de inscrição não serão devolvidas em nenhuma circunstância. - Não serão aceitas inscrições no local. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Registration fees will not be refunded under any circumstances. - On-site registrations will not be accepted. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: La calurosa ciudad de Lerdo de Tejada les da la bienvenida su primera competencia oficial donde no importa si eres principiante o veterano, todos tienen cabida y oportunidad de ganar. El auditorio del teatro municipal está listo para recibirles a todos en sus instalaciones equipadas de aire acondcionado para que disfruten al máximo de esta competencia. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE2MDMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fc944bdaf91972d6f8ab758dc8178c0971758464/Logov1.png) The warm Lerdo de Tejada town invites you to its first official cubing competition. It doesn't matter if you are a beginner or an expert; everybody is welcome. The local theatre auditorium is ready to welcome all of you to its AC-equipped installations so you can enjoy most of this two-day competition. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: Volos Wild Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIwODI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be406f2472acbf959e21897f27b9bdc0460b0ad7/536296154_1486549299105261_4236201959451164819_n.jpg) Το Volos Wild Open 2025 θα είναι ο διαγωνισμός με τα περισσότερα events στην Ελλάδα για το 2025 μέχρι στιγμής και ο πρώτος που θα γίνει ποτέ στην πόλη του Βόλου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του VALIS HOTEL για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) Volos Wild Open 2025 will be the competition with the most events in Greece for 2025 so far, and the very first ever held in Volos! In the conference hall of VALIS HOTEL, for 2 days, old and new, young and older Cubers from all over the country – and beyond – will meet again for our favorite hobby. Bring your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come join us for yet another celebration of cubing! Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, both steps are required: 1. Completing the registration on the competition’s WCA page **AND** 2. items.name: Voula Summer Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25a11a161841639a3cff2ecfb046c27deb82697e/Cubestore_VSO23_post.jpg) Το Voula Summer Open 2023 είναι ο 3oς WCA διαγωνισμός στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Είμαστε περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών "Road to Greek Nationals" εστιάζουμε σε κάθε διαγωνισμό σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε στο ελληνικό κοινό τα αγωνίσματα του One Handed/Λύση με ένα χέρι και του Fewest Move Challenge (FMC)/Δοκιμασία λύσης με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος μας είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα της Ελλάδας προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα WCA events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) The Voula Open 2023 is the third competition this year in Greece. We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! During each "Road to Greek finals" competition, we focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we are aiming to bring the events One Handed and Fewest Move Challenge (FMC) closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all WCA events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: This Fewest Moves competition is part of the **WCA African Championship for 2026**, but is being hosted 3 weeks before the main Championship in several separate countries and venues across the continent. Please see the **Locations** tab for more information. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU0MTA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e29e3f5ea7fe3728a156b02818d2878a1ffc9ce/2026_African_Champs_Logo.png) Please note that only the **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** will be held - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or fewer (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. Please see [this section](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) of the WCA Regulations for more information on Fewest Moves solving. There will be a short break inbetween attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors. For the website for the main WCA African Championship taking place in Cape Town, South Africa, please visit the [official WCA website](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCAAfricanChampionship2026) and the [official CubingZA website](https://cubingza.org/wca-african-championship-2026/). **GUESTS** Please note that guests and spectators are **not encouraged** at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt. **VENUES** Please see the **Locations** tab for more info! If you are a Junior or Full Delegate and would like to host a location in Africa for this competition, please reach out to the organizers! items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMyMDcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4efe096657d5e0709c184fa20b7d53a5857ba9a7/551543473_726119743805711_8970889758942482893_n.jpg) Το τρίτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα πλησιάζει και αυτός θα είναι ο τελευταίος διαγωνισμός πριν την διεξαγωγή του. Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του ΚΥΒΕ Περιστερίου για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο, θα συναντηθούμε ξανά πριν ταξιδέψουμε βόρεια για το μεγάλο speedcubing φινάλε του 2025 . Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The 3rd national championship (Greek Nationals 2025) is approaching, and this will be the last competition before the big event! In the conference hall of KYBE cultural centre of Peristeri, for two days, experienced and new comers, young and older cubers from all over the country — and beyond — will meet once again before we head north for the grand speedcubing finale of 2025. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another celebration of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: North Carolina and Southeast Cubing, Inc. would like to welcome everyone to Raleigh for **[Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026)**! This Pride competition is to celebrate and support LGBTQ+ cubers and allies. Any person may register for this competition. **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71720-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. $5 from every registration will be donated to **[The Trevor Project](https://www.thetrevorproject.org/)**. Their mission is to end suicide among LGBTQ+ young people and provide them support. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! items.name: Warm Up Seattle 2025
items.information: Welcome to the Pacific Northwest! [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2xBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--740c53d289def878faa5292856a4438109c059dc/image.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing) * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.pnwcubing.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) * [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/39HzT57upV) Warm Up Seattle 2025 is an exciting event for both attendees of the World Championships 2025 and folks who are not able to attend the championship. This competition is a **favorites** competition where you may register for up to 6 events (FTO does not count towards this limit). By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpSeattle2025#52996-please-read-competitor-responsibilities-schedule-explanation).

items.name: Warm Up Seattle PBQ 2025
items.information: Welcome to the Pacific Northwest! [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2xBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--740c53d289def878faa5292856a4438109c059dc/image.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing) * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.pnwcubing.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) * [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/39HzT57upV) Warm Up Seattle PBQ 2025 is an exciting event for both attendees of the World Championships 2025 and folks who are not able to attend the championship. This WCA page is for a Friday **PBQ** containing only 4x4 blindfolded, 5x5 blindfolded, and 3x3 Mult-Blind. On Saturday and Sunday, there is also a more traditional favorites-style competition. View more information or register for that competition [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpSeattle2025). By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpSeattle2025#52996-please-read-competitor-responsibilities-schedule-explanation).

items.information: Welcome to Warm Up Stockholm 2022! This is a pre-competition to the Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022 in Copenhagen the weekend after. You are warmly welcome to compete, regardless of whether you solve the 3x3-cube in 4 seconds or 4 minutes. Please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. -- Varmt välkommen till Warm Up Stockholm 2022! Detta är en förtävling till Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022 i Köpenhamn helgen efter. Du är varmt välkommen att tävla, oavsett om du löser 3x3-kuben på 4 sekunder eller 4 minuter. Vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information kring tävlingen.

items.information: We are excited to announce Warm Up Vancouver 2025! This official WCA competition will take place less than three weeks before the 2025 World Championship in Seattle. [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWh2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f989abe60a5b9303f42de97dee94ad812338f4b3/image.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en) **Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). **Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. Masks will be optional. Do not attend if you feel/are sick.

items.name: Warm-Up Warsaw 2025
items.information: Zapraszamy serdecznie na rozgrzewkę przed Mistrzostwami Świata! W ramach naszych zawodów będziemy układać dwie popularne konkurencje: 3x3x3 i Pyraminx. Mamy nadzieję, że uda się nam razem dobrze przygotować zarówno do oglądania jak i ukladania na najważniejszej imprezie tego roku. --- We invite everyone to warm-up before World Championship! In course of our competition we will compete in two popular events: 3x3x3 and Pyraminx. We hope that we will be able to properly warm up both for watching and solving at the most important competition of this year.
